title: Closing and Funding: Number of Closings a Customer May Hold
content:
**Rule.** Under the Closing and Funding product, a customer may have closings on several loan files over time. There is no limit on the number of closings per customer. Each closing belongs to one loan file, and how many closings may be open on one loan file is governed by the per-file closing rule, not by this one.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a per-customer cap on closings? | No; the number per customer is unlimited. |
| Can one closing serve two loan files? | No; each closing belongs to one loan file. |
| Does this rule decide how many closings may be open on one file? | No; that is decided per loan file. |

Example (hypothetical): a borrower who closed a Larkspur purchase loan in an earlier year and now refinances another home holds two Closing and Funding engagements, one on each loan file; nothing in this rule limits that.
